headline: D4vd's Texts EXPOSE Baby Mama Drama 💀👶💥
text: Texts between singer D4vd 🕴️🎤 and 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez 💔📱 reveal she was PREGNANT 🤰 and had an ABORTION 💊 before her death. Prosecutors say D4vd started ABUSING the girl when she was 13 😭 and she threatened to EXPOSE him and DESTROY his career 💣. "What if the first abortion didn't work?" she texted him in June 2024. He was 19, she was 13. Burke apologized for "putting her through this" and asked "it is mine right?" Celeste replied "of course its yours David." In another text, he wrote "Let's let this abortion be the last one til we have the real one." The court saw iCloud data dating back to August 2022 when she was 11 and he was 17. His phone had PHOTOS of the alleged abuse 📸. The victim's mom Mercedes left court in tears 😢. They planned to move in together in "Operation Awesome" 🏠. They "broke up" in November 2024 but stayed in contact. Prosecutors say they argued the night before her death over his other women. DNA from blood in his Hollywood Hills home matched Celeste. D4vd was on tour when her body was found in his Tesla boot 🚗💀. His tour got CANCELLED and he ghosted social media 👻. Now facing 7 charges including murder, continuous sexual abuse, and mutilation of remains. She was last seen at his house in April 2025. He met her online at 11, allegedly started abusing her at 13. Gruesome details continue Monday.
